LICENSE file. See each subdirectory's LICENSE for full terms.

| `Pixelbolt/` | https://github.com/skulitom/Pixelbolt | `9b95327091039a87659aecc12544e44d0d70852f` | MIT |
| `ppae-engine/` | https://github.com/Mairon31/ppae-engine | `ed98da220d9ac30e35b23da555d60f5a0ec84a51` | Apache-2.0 |

| `Pixelorama/` | https://github.com/Orama-Interactive/Pixelorama | `fae9327992f1506f340b920e0fa6515a88298079` | MIT |

## Excluded files

spritekiln marks some files as `LicenseRef-Showcase` (all rights reserved, not
licensed for reuse in other projects). They were **not** copied:

- `showcase/`
- `specs/characters/templar/`, `specs/characters/huntress/`
- `specs/props/mine/`
- `specs/palettes/templar.yaml`, `specs/palettes/huntress.yaml`

Code or docs in spritekiln may still reference these paths.
